labels.defaultAudience: A proposal for hotels in Tashkent
labels.plaqueCaption: An A5 plaque in every room

cover.title: Guest services in every room
cover.lead: Tours, transfers and tickets from a QR code in the room. We do all the work; the hotel is paid for every completed request.

problem.title: A guest asks at reception — and ends up with a random taxi

cards.title: Front desk time
cards.text: An airport run, a city tour, a train ticket: every one of these questions takes the front desk's time, often at its busiest hour.

cards.title: Money passing by
cards.text: The guest pays anyway — a driver at the door or an agency found online. The hotel earns nothing and does not know who it trusted its guest to.

cards.title: Language
cards.text: Guests from China, Europe, the Gulf. Not every shift has someone at the desk who speaks their language.

solution.title: Four steps, and the hotel takes one of them

steps.title: We print the plaques
steps.text: A plaque with its own QR code for every room. We check each code before handing it over.

steps.title: The guest scans
steps.text: No app, no sign-up. The page opens in English, and the guest can switch to Russian, Uzbek or Chinese.

steps.title: The request reaches us
steps.text: In seconds. We contact the guest, confirm the price and the details, and arrange everything.

steps.title: The hotel is paid
steps.text: For every completed request, at a fixed rate.

guest.title: A plaque in the room and a page with your hotel's name
points: Your hotel's name and the room number on the page
4 languages: English, Русский, Oʻzbekcha, 中文
The price is confirmed before payment; the site takes no money and asks for no passport or card
Rides can be ordered “as soon as possible”
After the request, the guest can message us on WhatsApp straight away

services.title: Everything guests ask the front desk about

items.name: Airport meet & greet with a name board
Tashkent tour with a private guide
Car and driver for the day

services.note: Starting prices. We confirm the total with the guest before payment.

roles.title: The hotel gives us a room list. Everything else is our job
hotel: Gives us the list of rooms
Sees requests and payouts in its own account
us: Sets up the hotel and prints the plaques
Checks every code before handing it over
Takes each request and contacts the guest
Confirms price and details before payment
Arranges the driver, the guide or the tickets

earnings.title: Paid per completed request, not a share of revenue
earnings.restaurants: Restaurant bookings are not paid: nobody earns on them.
earnings.footnote: The rate is written into the request when it is completed. Payouts are in US dollars.

example.title: What this can look like for a large hotel
example.disclaimer: An example calculation, not a forecast: it depends on your guests. The formula is always the same — completed requests × rate + volume bonus.

points.title: Your own login
points.text: Every request from your rooms: room, service, status and payout. For any month.

points.title: You see only yours, and only you do
points.text: The separation is enforced in the database itself, not in the interface.

points.title: No retroactive changes
points.text: The terms are written into the request when it is completed.

points.title: You never need our revenue
points.text: The payout does not depend on what the guest paid.

bigHotel.title: What matters to a large hotel

points.title: Your name on the page
points.text: The guest sees your hotel's name and their own room number.

points.title: An honest price
points.text: The price is confirmed before payment. The site takes no money and asks for no passport or card.

points.title: Four languages
points.text: English, Русский, Oʻzbekcha, 中文. The guest switches language themselves.

points.title: Works alongside your concierge
points.text: It catches the guests who never reach the desk — and the hotel is paid for them too.

points.title: Full control
points.text: Switching the hotel off disables every code in every room at once.

points.title: Fully transparent
points.text: Every request and every payout is visible in your account.
